# FLX-3101: declared contractDigest does not match the in-bundle contract

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

KERNEL-SPEC §8 recomputes the referenced FLUID document's digest from the bytes actually in the bundle and compares it with the digest the emit declares. A mismatch means the contract that was reviewed is not the contract that would ship, which is the one thing the seam exists to make impossible. Re-run plan to refresh the declared digest, or restore the contract the digest was taken over.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3101
```
